issue.name: Repeated nearest selection resize irreversibly resamples previous displayed pixels
issue.trigger: Original opaque/keyOFF rect3x2, separate pointer gestures3x2→2x3→3x2; original six labels become0,0,2,3,3,5 instead of0,1,2,3,4,5, then settle creates a false edit and consumes old Redo.
issue.rootCause: Each gesture snapshots current already-resampled Raster; dialog also passed current pixels to geometry. Original sourceMask/sourceRect were already correctly independent and are not the defect.
issue.baselineScope: Two public SRE cases: same-gesture reference recovery already passed, distinct-gesture recovery failed3 related assertions. One product defect, not3. Root separate reproduction confirms same lost labels, no private Studio hook.

qt.limits: Actual Qt public Canvas oracle, not12 browser/native UI cases. Qt premultiplied storage RGB differs from TS raw policy. Same-gesture Qt not observed; web pointer protection separately verified. Four rotations with transparent key are not assumed NoOp: actualQt7 key pixels change.

implementation.fix: Persistent nearest-resize backing descriptor, no backing copy. Freeze drag sampling base from snapshot for entire gesture. Restore current/base/modified on same-gesture return and cancel. Async base input is copied for Worker and checked before publication. Successful rotate/flip/shear materializes displayed current then releases old base.
implementation.identity: originalPixels is initial-selection NoOp identity used by pointer/Arrow movement and pointer resize; explicit async geometry success preserves modified=true and sets originalPixels=undefined after all checks. This invalidates a comparison reference, not original document pixels/sourceMask. Same-size dialog early return and failures do not invalidate it.
implementation.guards: Abort/document identity/revision/epoch/active/selection/current Raster identity and dimensions plus captured resizeSource identity; final aggregate limits before synchronized field publication.
implementation.sourceMask: Original source rect/mask are unchanged by payload geometry. Clear uses original stride; copy/render/settle use transformed payload geometry.
reviewCorrections: Freeze the entire gesture base, rather than reading mutable q.resizeSource after visiting original dimensions.

performanceAndMemory.ownership: Backing descriptor retains a reference, no backing clone at creation. Current4*R and backing4*B can be distinct or alias. Pointer initial originalPixels can alias base. Successful explicit geometry releases originalPixels, so do not always add an old4*S plane. SourceMask retains originalS bytes.
performanceAndMemory.transient: Async input clones base4*B, not shrunken displayed4*R, and Worker output is extra4*Rnext. Exact-base async return still performs Worker clone/resize before reusing preserved identity; no CPU/allocation savings inferred.
performanceAndMemory.observedWKReferences: Tiny3x2 roundtrip current/base unique explicit buffers24→48→24bytes; rotation followed6x4 resize retains24+96=120bytes. This counts only selection field buffers, excluding document/cache/Canvas/Worker/transients/RSS.
